records.title: Soak checkpoint ordering can skip after-cycle faults or duplicate injected faults after a crash
records.relevant_release_upgrade_or_soak_object: Failure exactly-once state and cycle checkpoint progression

source_evidence.note: cycle_observed advances persisted completedCycleCount before after_cycle failures execute.
failure_injected is checkpointed before the side effect, while deduplication uses only the in-memory failures array populated after recovery.

records.preconditions: The process crashes after cycle_observed but before after_cycle injection, or after failure_injected/side effect but before recovery and in-memory failure recording.
records.trigger: Resume the campaign.
records.expected_behavior: Every scheduled fault must be durably exactly-once or explicitly safely replayable, and completedCycleCount must not skip any required stage.
records.current_behavior: After-cycle work can be skipped because resume starts at completedCycleCount+1; an injected fault can run again because the durable checkpoint is not used for deduplication.
records.impact: Named failure coverage becomes incomplete or duplicate destructive effects occur, while retained state can still look progressive.
records.evidence: Static crash-window models reproduce both skip and duplicate paths.

reproduction_status.result: Crash windows cause skipped after_cycle fault and repeated injected fault.

records.transaction_or_state_machine_analysis: The durable cycle state and durable failure state are not one monotonic transaction. EPHEMERAL_EXECUTED_SET is lost across restart.
records.root_cause: Checkpoint sequencing records intent/progress at boundaries that do not correspond to completed side effects and does not reconstruct fault state from checkpoints.
records.minimal_fix_boundary: Model each injection with durable pending/injected/recovery_verified states and an idempotency token; derive resume work from the checkpoint chain; advance cycle completion only after all required stages are terminal.
required_tests: crash at every line between fault checkpoint, side effect, recovery checkpoint, and cycle completion
regression_risks: Some real failures are inherently non-idempotent and need compensation/fencing.
